title: Illustration: Primary Stripes
slide_intent: Ground an abstract motif in recognizable ingredients so its colors and proportions communicate a food association rather than arbitrary decoration.
strategic_value: A stripe system derived from the Whopper can give Burger King a proprietary graphic reference beyond its logo.
demonstration: A left explanation accompanies a large striped rectangle labeled from bun crown through lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and patty to bun heel.
practical_value: Trace each stripe to its ingredient reference when choosing or assessing the primary artwork.

content_islands.name: Food rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation of the Whopper cross-section at left.

content_islands.name: Labeled stripe diagram
content_islands.spec: Show the layered rectangle at right with small ingredient labels inside the corresponding bands.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy explains that the stripes take their inspiration directly from the Whopper and its ingredient layers.
reference_purposes.Expression: The diagram presents uneven, food-colored bands of different thicknesses.
reference_purposes.Application: Labels connect each band to an ingredient and establish the shown order.

ingredient.name: Primary illustration stripes
ingredient.role: Refer to a Whopper cross-section without literal food photography.
ingredient.application: Use the layered stripe artwork with its ingredient order intact.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide. Body copy mentions mayo while the diagram labels the white band Onion Rings; preserve that source inconsistency. No numeric band proportions are specified.
